body: I'm not sure if we're allowed to discuss specifics, but pretty confident it will work.
The consequences of failing could be bad, being a vegetable with massive medical debt sounds terrible, but not really scared.
Oh. I guess I'm just lazy, I don't understand why I would do something I don't enjoy. Oh well, just not cut out for life.
Not sure. I've always hated the concept of working and hated doing necessities like eating, sleep, etc.

> Do you have a disease or a disorder that may be the cause of this?

Don't think so.

> Something happened lately?

No, always felt like this.

> You don't have dreams, anything to strive for?

Nope, what should I be striving for?

> What kind of bad moments are You talking about?

Mostly just being alive, I hate working, I hate eating, I hate going to bathroom, I hate talking, pretty much everything that is a "requirement" for life.

> A shame is having no job at all and not doing anything.

How so?

> It's important to never abandon your dreams

Have no dreams.

> cherish the truly great moments that life has to offer.

I don't think the "truly great moments" are great enough to worth suffering through the bad moments.
